visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ list of collapsible question/answer items with right chevrons, dividers and tinted answer panels
notes: No project accordion; FAQ list with magenta serif questions, right chevrons, grey dividers and tinted answer panels.

contentPattern.structure: question cell (plain text or heading) and answer cell (paragraphs, lists, small footnotes)

usage: Use for FAQ sections; one block per FAQ list.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any collapsible question/answer list.
